answer: Latency-Bid Inclusion Barrier. Each new identity must submit a small bid that is held for a umber cooling period before any payout; bids are pooled per epoch and released only to agents whose work cleared a minimum. Clones pay the bid plus idle time, and because rewards route through the shared atlas of settled epochs, a clone's expected share stays below its hold cost. The grove of active agents grows only when marginal identities clear that bar, making each added clone strictly negative-EV.
